description: This HTML file implements a web-based database viewer interface with client-side JavaScript for dynamically fetching and displaying database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects, nulls, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long or object data types.
